name: Wise Personal
description: Wise Personal is a multi-currency account and international money-transfer product for individuals. Customers use it to hold and convert supported currencies, send money, receive account details, use a Wise card where available, and track personal transfers.
agentUseSummary: Wise Personal is visible as a partner-review preview only. Relay will not collect a Wise password, browser session, Wise Business personal API token, payment credential, or identity-verification data, and no agent action is callable until Wise approves a customer OAuth and mTLS contract for personal profiles.

capabilities.label: Read approved personal data
capabilities.description: After partner approval, expose only the provider-approved non-mutating personal-profile, balance, exchange-rate, and exact transfer-status surface documented in Relay's signed Wise Platform contract.

blocked.label: Connect before partner approval
blocked.description: Relay has no current Wise Platform partnership, approved customer OAuth application, client credentials, mTLS certificate, redirect registration, sandbox tenant, personal-profile scope, permitted operation list, or compliance allocation.

blocked.label: Collect customer credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask customers for a Wise password, browser session, bearer token, Wise Business personal API token, card or bank credential, identity document, tax identifier, or verification response as a substitute for provider-approved OAuth.

blocked.label: Run Wise Personal API actions
blocked.description: No personal-profile, balance, rate, quote, recipient, transfer, card, account-detail, identity, statement, webhook, or status API action can run while partner review is pending.

blocked.label: Money movement unavailable
blocked.description: Creating quotes for execution, recipients, transfers, funding instructions, conversions, balance movements, account details, cards, cancellations, refunds, or other financial mutations remains outside Relay's planned read-only V1 even after partner approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Partner review pending
approvalProfiles.description: Agent actions remain unavailable until Wise approves Relay's customer OAuth integration and engineering implements and validates the exact read-only personal-profile contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until Wise approves Relay and Relay implements the contracted read-only Railway broker.
No Hermes tools are callable until Wise approves Relay and Relay implements the contracted read-only Railway broker.

providerSetup.blocker: Wise Platform customer OAuth requires a partnership agreement, Wise-issued client credentials, a coordinated redirect URL, mTLS, sandbox and production onboarding, and an approved integration access model. Wise's current personal API-token guide applies to a customer's own Wise Business account rather than Wise Personal, so Relay cannot honestly collect that token for this provider. Relay has no approved customer OAuth application, personal-profile scope, mTLS material, sandbox tenant, compliance allocation, or permitted operation list.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Relay business, security, and compliance owner must complete Wise Platform partnership review and obtain a customer authorization contract covering personal profiles, exact OAuth scopes and consent copy, redirect registration, mTLS and certificate lifecycle, token refresh and revocation rules, supported jurisdictions, permitted read-only profile, balance, rate, and transfer-status endpoints, data minimization and retention, rate limits, webhooks, sandbox users, and production onboarding. Engineering can then implement a fixed-origin Railway OAuth broker and the smallest bounded read-only personal-account V1, with encrypted tokens, serialized refresh, redaction, audit, disconnect, revocation, and post-disconnect denial. Money movement remains excluded.

evidence.supports: Wise Platform requires partnership onboarding for OAuth 2.0, Wise-issued client credentials, a registered redirect URL, and mTLS; customer-facing integrations use the partner authorization model.

Wise's current personal API-token guide limits self-service tokens to a customer's own Wise Business account and a bounded payout workflow, so it is not an authorization contract for the Wise Personal provider.

Wise documents partner user authorization through an authorization-code redirect and token exchange using a Wise-issued client ID and secret, with access and refresh tokens managed under the approved integration model.
Wise Platform models both personal and business profiles and exposes financial resources only to callers holding valid Wise-issued user or personal-token authority.

Wise's help centre says personal customers use the API for transfers, status monitoring, and statements, but it does not provide Relay with a self-service distributable customer authorization application.
